title: Documents & publishing
subtitle: Keep a reliable source. Prepare the right version for each channel.
externalHint: The source directory stays read-only. Edits are stored as separate PandaForce drafts.
managedHint: Drafts and revision history are stored in PandaForce.

noDocumentsHint: Create a draft, or scan the connected source directory.

busy: The image service is busy. Please retry shortly.
languageConflict: A linked document already uses this language. Unlink it or choose another language.

languageHint: Link documents that represent the same article in different languages. Their content and revision histories remain independent.

saveBeforeImport: Save your draft before importing source images.

imageExternal: Remote image: download it yourself and upload it through Images.

imageUnavailable: File could not be read safely. Check permissions, size and symbolic links.

themeHint: The selected theme version is frozen into each new build. Existing builds and publication plans keep their original presentation.
themeReaderHint: Clear typography and a spacious single-column blog.
themeJournalHint: A warm serif theme for long-form essays.
themeHandbookHint: A documentation site with navigation and comfortable reading width.
themeReferenceHint: A wider, compact layout for technical reference.
unknownTheme: This theme version is not installed. Select an available version.
incompatibleTheme: The selected theme does not support this engine. Choose a compatible theme.
themeUpdated: Site theme updated. New builds will use this version.
spaceConflict: The document space settings changed. Open the settings again to review the current version.
invalidSourceConfiguration: This source configuration is invalid or contains unsupported settings. Review the public profile.
sourceResourcesTooLarge: Selected site resources exceed the file or size limits. Narrow the resource rules.
sourceResourceConflict: Two source resources map to conflicting output paths. Use unique paths.
sourceEditionMissing: Configure this language edition in Source settings before building it.
sourceSettingsHint: Import public Hexo settings from the existing project. Source files remain read-only. Choose configuration files in the order they should be merged.
sourceWebp: Use source image variants and WebP companions

sourceEditExisting: Edit the saved public profile instead of importing files
sourceReviewHint: Only this public profile will be saved. Review language editions, static resource rules and image settings. Execution paths, commands and credentials are excluded.

sourceProfileUpdated: Source settings saved. Refresh the source before creating a new build.

noSourceThemes: No theme directories were found in this source project.
themeDependenciesHint: The default worker includes these modules. Remove modules that are not required or specify exact versions available in your administrator-selected worker. Packages never install dependencies.

deleteDocumentHint: Move this document to trash? Its content, images and history can be restored.

originalUnchanged: Your original, images and revision history stay in project documents.

publicationLinkHint: This link selects saved content for a website. It does not move the original or publish it.
followLatestRevision: Follow latest saved version (currently revision {number, number})

removePublicationLinkHint: Remove this destination link? The original, images, revision history and existing build records remain available.

moveToRootHint: Drop here to move to the project root
searchLocationHint: Showing up to 100 matching destinations. Search to narrow the list.
saveBeforeTreeChange: Wait for the current document to finish saving before changing its title or moving it to trash.

restoredToRoot: The original parent is unavailable. The document was restored to the project root.
editorLoadFailed: The editor could not be downloaded. You can keep reading and retry.
editorLoadUnavailable: The editor could not load. You can keep reading; reload this page to try again.
editorStartFailed: The editor could not start. Your content remains available for reading.
editorStillLoading: The editor is taking longer than expected. Your content is safe; retry to continue loading.
filePreviewHint: Drafts save automatically. Save a version before configuring website destinations or creating a build.
localRecovery: Local changes are kept in this browser tab. Export them before reloading a conflicting document.
saveBeforeRestore: Save a version of your changes before restoring history.

workingCopyChanged: Save or discard unsaved changes before applying suggestions to the saved original.
